name: PJ Western (Papa John's Russia)
note: Operator of the Papa John's chain in Russia. TAdviser (2026): Christopher Wynne left the founders in June 2026; his 75% stake in OOO 'Pi Dzhey Franchizing Rus' passed to the company itself; the remaining 25% belongs to OOO 'Pi Dzhey Eurasia', controlled by the Cypriot PJ Western Retail Investments Limited.
